claims: Jon Scheyer is the head men's basketball coach at Duke University.
Jon Scheyer took over the head men's basketball coach role at Duke University from Mike Krzyzewski in 2022.
As of March 2026, Jon Scheyer has led the Blue Devils to ACC Tournament titles.
As of March 2026, Jon Scheyer has led the Blue Devils to a 2025 Final Four appearance.
As of March 2026, Jon Scheyer has secured a long-term contract extension.
